description_en: Queries the information about all active streams under a specified domain name or a specific application under the domain name
description_zh: 查看指定域名下（或者指定域名下某个应用）的所有正在推的流的信息
name: DescribeVsStreamsOnlineList

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 3000. Valid values: 1 to 3000
parameters.help_zh:
每页大小。默认值：3000。

取值范围：[1,3000]
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The stream type. Valid values:
all: All streams. This is the default value.
raw: Raw streams.
trans: Transcoded streams
parameters.help_zh:
流类型。取值范围：
all（所有流）（默认）
raw（原始流）
trans（转码流）
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en:
The start time.
The time must be in UTC format, for example, 2016-06-29T19:00:00Z
parameters.help_zh:
起始时间。
为UTC格式，例如：2016-06-29T19:00:00Z
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time.
The time must be in UTC format, for example, 2016-06-30T19:00:00Z.
The interval between the end time and the start time cannot exceed 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。
为UTC格式，例如：2016-06-30T19:00:00Z
EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过30天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to fuzzy match the stream name. Valid values:
fuzzy: Fuzzy match.
strict: Exact match
parameters.help_zh:
指定是否模糊匹配流名称。取值范围：
fuzzy（模糊匹配）
strict（精准匹配）
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en:
The sorting method. Valid values:
stream_name_desc: Sort by live stream name in descending order.
stream_name_asc: Sort by live stream name in ascending order.
publish_time_desc: Sort by stream ingest time in descending order.
publish_time_asc: Sort by stream ingest time in ascending order. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值范围：
stream_name_desc（按直播流名称倒序）
stream_name_asc（按直播流名称升序）
publish_time_desc（按推流时间倒序）
publish_time_asc（按推流时间升序）（默认值）
parameters.name: order_by

LiveStreamOnlineInfo.description_en: The information about the active streams

AppName.description_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs

DomainName.description_en: The accelerated domain name to which the stream belongs

PublishTime.description_en: The time when the stream ingest started. The time is in UTC

PublishType.description_en:
The stream ingest type. Valid values:
edge: Edge stream ingest.
center: Center stream ingest
PublishType.description_zh:
推流类型。取值范围：
edge（边缘推流）
center（中心推流）

PublishUrl.description_en: The complete URL for stream ingest

TranscodeId.description_en:
The ID of the transcoding template.
If the stream is transcoded, the ID of the transcoding template is returned.
For a raw stream, a list of IDs of the transcoding templates configured under the current AppName is returned, separated by commas (,)
TranscodeId.description_zh:
转码模板ID。
若转码过，会返回转码模板ID。
对于原始流，返回当前AppName下配置的转码模板ID列表，用英文逗号（,）分隔

Transcoded.description_en:
Indicates whether the stream is a transcoded stream. Valid values:
yes: Yes.
no: No
Transcoded.description_zh:
是否为转码流。取值范围：
yes（是）
no（否）

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the conditions
